title: Watersound 37 Compass Point Way Unit 110
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gated Community with on-site Security- Private deeded beach access- Minutes to the nearest beach boardwalk- Screened-in porches- 3 adult bikes- From March 1st to October 31st, the rental of this property includes one beach -service set (2 beach chairs and 1 umbrella)- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutThis home permits a maximum of 1 vehicle through the community security gate.DETAILS: Photos and additional details coming soon!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 8):FIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate- Additional Sleeping Area: Twin-over-Twin Bunk BedSECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Two Twin Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo*Watersound Community Highlights:-Over 250 Acre Gated Beach Community on the Gulf of Mexico between Seaside and Rosemary Beach-(2) Community Pools (Dunesider Pool in Main Gate and Bridges Pool within the Bridges Gate)-Kayak Rentals-Parks, Walking Trails and Meandering Boardwalks-Bike to Alys, Seacrest and Rosemary Beach-A short walk to The Big ChillPlease Note:*From October 2025 through 2026, WaterSound Compass Point will undergo major exterior refurbishment. Residents and guests should expect construction, boarded windows, limited balcony and garage access, and possible parking disruptions. These safety measures are essential for project completion.*Access to the Watersound Beach Club is not included.*Watersound does not allow Low-Speed Vehicle rentals from outside vendors.*Weddings or parties/groups of people or guest of guest are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.*Guests have access to the garage for storage, but NOT for parking.
